versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \rundll32.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-sta '
        - '–localserver '
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '{'
        - '}'
condition: selection

versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-sta '
        - '-localserver '
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '{'
        - '}'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\rundll32.exe" OR OriginalFileName="RUNDLL32.EXE" CommandLine IN ("*-sta *", "*-localserver *") CommandLine="*{*" CommandLine="*}*"
